arm_then_fire._note: Leading macro factors in risk zone ease status thresholds (earlier fire) only while armed. OFF by default; calibrate relief_cap via PBO before enabling. arm_high/low_fields list the SOFT percentile fields used for arming — fields not collected (data_* flag OFF) return None and are skipped automatically. Fields shared with additive A-factors (e.g. move_pctl↔A18, nfci_pctl↔A17) create a coupling: enabling that data_* flag means the signal is both additive and arming; run PBO gate on the combination, not each in isolation.

hard_valves._hm2_note: ⑤ When use_hm2_buffer on, a LONE H-M2 (single -15% day below EMA10, no other valve) is downgraded from instant 100% EXIT to this status floor (DEFENSIVE_EXIT=75% for MSTR). Diagnostic: H-M2 is near-pure whipsaw (0% crash-hit, median fwd20 +18%); a real continuation fires H-M1/H-M4/H-M6 to force full exit. Default OFF.

soft_data_slo._note: T9: when features.use_soft_data_max_age is on, soft records whose latency_days (each source's own staleness measure, the same one data_quality consumes) exceeds max_age are degraded to missing so they flow through missing_weight instead of scoring with stale percentiles. Thresholds are long-weekend-safe (daily ~6 covers a holiday weekend; weekly 13 covers one skipped release). Default OFF; flip is an F4-class live-robustness gate (expected backtest no-op on complete history).
